_derivation.note: official_fields.json is curated from the Stripe API reference objects (charges, balance_transactions, invoices, subscriptions, refunds, payouts, customers). Fields are derived from the official object schemas at docs.stripe.com/api. Reporting-relevant scalar and aggregate fields are included; deeply-nested payment-method variant fields (e.g. payment_method_details.card.checks.*, card_present.receipt.*) are excluded as they do not bear reporting metrics. The Stripe API is versioned via a request header (Stripe-Version), not the URL path; api_version refers to the header value pinned in connector.py.
_derivation.manifest_field_coverage: All 9 fields in manifest.json source_capabilities.fields are present in official_fields.json with matching kind and source_field. These 9 fields are marked exposure='exposed'; all remaining fields are 'planned'.
_derivation.supermetrics_enrichment: Supermetrics catalog for Stripe lists 62 metrics / 206 dimensions (fetched 2026-07-21 from https://docs.supermetrics.com/docs/stripe-fields.md). Enrichment-only fields (e.g. coupon_id, app_fee_id, balance_source_card counts, transaction_charge_percent) are documented in this file but NOT emitted in official_fields.json — enrichment is never the authority per the playbook. Supermetrics coverage is used to validate tier assignments and discover missed sections.

sources._fetch: curl -sL https://docs.supermetrics.com/docs/stripe-fields.md -o server/modules/stripe/catalog_sources/supermetrics.md   # DO NOT COMMIT this file (enrichment snapshot only)

probe.structural_note: Stripe list endpoints return whole objects over a created[] window (limit=1) with expand[] for nested fields (e.g. balance_transaction.fee). Fields are ratified by presence in the returned object; a field absent from a non-empty object is recorded empty, an expand target Stripe rejects is recorded unsupported after bisection.

excluded_sections.CUSTOMER: Customer object is not expanded by the charge fetch; charge.customer contains only the customer id string, not the full Customer object. Requires a separate /v1/customers/{id} call per charge, which is not performed by the daily pull.
excluded_sections.INVOICE: Invoice objects are not fetched by the daily pull; requires additional endpoint fetches (/v1/invoices). The daily pull reads /v1/charges only.
excluded_sections.SUBSCRIPTION: Subscription objects are not fetched by the daily pull; requires additional endpoint fetches (/v1/subscriptions). The daily pull reads /v1/charges only.
excluded_sections.REFUND: Individual Refund sub-objects are not fetched by the daily pull; charge.amount_refunded (already exposed as the refunds metric via PLATFORM CONTRACT) is a scalar total on the Charge, not the list of Refund objects. Requires a separate /v1/refunds call, which is not performed by the daily pull.
excluded_sections.PAYOUT: Payout objects are not fetched by the daily pull; requires additional endpoint fetches (/v1/payouts). The daily pull reads /v1/charges only.

_exposure_note: Story 25.9: exposure_policy=catalog_driven. Fetchable sections (CHARGE, BALANCE TRANSACTION, PLATFORM CONTRACT) have their fields set to exposure=catalog_driven in api_catalog.json; excluded sections (CUSTOMER, INVOICE, SUBSCRIPTION, REFUND, PAYOUT) have their fields set to exposure=excluded with honest reasons. The daily pull calls /v1/charges with expand[]=data.balance_transaction, making Charge fields and their embedded BalanceTransaction available; all other object types require separate endpoint calls not performed here.
